# One-person company (一人公司) · agent entrypoint
> This environment belongs to one human principal. Agents may read and propose; only the human decides.

- Manifest: ./ae.json  (schema ae.manifest/0.1)
- Read `offers` to learn what this company does.
- To propose work: open an issue on this repository. Never accept, price, pay, or sign on the principal's behalf.
- Network registry of #opc nodes: https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/aeee-lab/lab/opc/registry.json

Evidence ≠ Authority. Many agents. One principal. #ioa #internetofagents #opensourceware
